title: NASA's Most Complicated Mission Yet!

scenes.text: Four astronauts, three spacecraft, two weeks in orbit!
Artemis III aims to land astronauts on the Moon in 2025.
NASA's bold return to the Moon!
scenes.label: BOLD RETURN
scenes.sub: Prepare for a new lunar age!

scenes.text: Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: Artemis III is set to revolutionize our understanding of the Moon and beyond. Follow for daily science!
